title: Clarify messaging: she left after one date, tone is 'please come back' not apologetic

requirements.summary: Update the main page message in MainCard to clearly reflect the context: she left after the first date saying 'this isn't working out', and the message is simply asking her to please come back and give it another chance. The tone must be sweet, hopeful, and sincere — centered on 'please come back 🥺' — without any framing of messing up, mistakes, or apologies.
acceptanceCriteria: The main page message prominently features the 🥺 emoji
The message asks Saachi to please come back after their first date
There is no language implying a longer relationship, a mistake, or an apology
The tone is sweet, hopeful, and sincere throughout
The Slytherin/Harry Potter visual theme remains consistent
